newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Senate confidence vote seen around 1800 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Italy Senate confidence vote seen around 1800 GMT.

text.p: A confidence vote called by the government in the Senate (upper house) to speed passage of a draft law on immigration is expected to be held at around 1800 GMT later on Wednesday, parliamentary party leaders said.

Interior Minister Giorgo Napolitano announced the vote earlier in the day, saying that some 7,000 opposition amendments would make consideration of the draft law "impossible in the time that the absolute urgency of the matter requires".
Parliamentary party leaders decided to start debate on the confidence motion immediately.
Prime Minister Romano Prodi's centre-left coalition has a sizeable majority in the assembly and did not appear at risk of a defeat on the motion. -- Rome newsroom +396 6782501
